tools.name: launchIde
tools.description: Launches the TCSAS-Devtools IDE. If a project path is provided, it opens the specified miniprogram project. Use this tool when the user wants to open the IDE or a specific project.

ideInstallPath.description: The absolute path to the IDE installation. This is optional; if omitted, the IDE will be launched with the default installation path.

path.description: The absolute path to the miniprogram project to open. This is optional; if omitted, the IDE will just be launched.

tools.name: checkIdeInstalled
tools.description: Checks if the TCSAS-Devtools IDE is installed on the user's system. Use this to verify the user's environment before attempting to launch the IDE.

tools.name: previewMiniProgramOnDevice
tools.description: Generates a QR code for REAL DEVICE preview. The user must manually scan this QR code with the TCSAS app on their phone to preview the miniprogram. This is ONLY for device preview - DO NOT use this to check execution results or get screenshots (use getMiniProgramRuntimeLog for that). Takes 60-80 seconds.

path.description: The absolute path of the miniprogram project to preview.

tools.name: uploadMiniprogram
tools.description: Uploads a new version of a miniprogram project from the specified path. Requires a version number and a description for the upload.

path.description: The absolute path of the miniprogram project to upload.

describeMessage.description: A short description of the changes in this version.

tools.name: getMiniProgramRuntimeLog
tools.description: IMPORTANT: Use this tool immediately after writing or modifying code to check if your changes work correctly. Returns the miniprogram's runtime execution results: 1) Console output (console.log, console.error, warnings), 2) Runtime errors if any, 3) Screenshot of the current page. This allows you to verify your code is working as expected and see the visual result without manual testing.

path.description: The absolute path of the miniprogram project.

needScreen.description: Whether to capture a screenshot. Default is false.

screenshotFormat.description: Screenshot format: 'png' (binary file) or 'base64' (text file). Default is 'png'.

logLevel.description: Filter logs by level. Can be one or more of: 'log', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'debug'. If not specified, all logs are returned.

tools.name: setCompileCondition
tools.description: Sets the compile condition for a miniprogram project. Use this to switch the startup page and pass page parameters for debugging specific pages. After setting, the miniprogram will launch with the specified page and parameters.

path.description: The absolute path of the miniprogram project.

query.description: Page parameters in query string format (e.g., 'id=123&type=test'). Optional.

simulateUpdate.description: Whether to simulate an update scenario. Default is false.

tools.name: deleteCompileCondition
tools.description: Deletes a compile condition from a miniprogram project by its name.

path.description: The absolute path of the miniprogram project.

conditionName.description: Name of the compile condition to delete.

serverInfo.name: TCSAS-Devtools for miniprogram development and debugging
